title: 2D Uniform Rectangular Structured Grid
description: Single-block 4x3 structured Cartesian grid in ASCII PLOT3D format with strictly positive right-handed cell Jacobians for a planar computational fluid dynamics domain.

title: Subsonic Channel Grid and Uniform Mach 0.3 Flow
description: Paired structured channel mesh (channel.xyz) and conservative PLOT3D flow solution (channel.q) at freestream Mach 0.30, Reynolds number 1.0e6, and sea-level standard density.

title: 3D Rectangular Duct Grid and Boundary-Layer Velocity Field
description: Three-dimensional 3x3x3 rectangular wind-tunnel duct structured mesh paired with a conservative flow solution capturing wall-normal velocity shear from the boundary layer to the core.

title: Two-Block Converging Nozzle Multi-Zone Grid and Solution
description: Multi-block PLOT3D converging-diverging propulsion nozzle with two matched 3x2x2 structured zones (converging inlet block and diverging diffuser block) and accelerating compressible flow solution.
